name: real-mixed-implement-strength-circuit-20260810
description: Real Gorillot doc 2026-08-10, in the shape the fixed logging path now saves. '4 sets: 5 Shoulder press (barbell) @80-85% / 10/10 DB row @RPE~8 / 8/8 single leg deadlift' — three movements, TWO implements, three different loads. Guards the mixed-implement strength circuit: each movement carries its OWN loggedWeights (40 / 22.5 / 20) and its own reps (5 / 10 / 8), and the exercise-level sets[] state the set count and the block's per-set rep total but NO shared weight — there isn't one. The bug this pins: SupersetInput used to treat any multi-set exercise with 1+ weighted movement as one shared bar and stamped a single 40kg + a single 10-rep count across all three.

workout.title: GORILLOT - FIT FOR LIFE
workout.rawText:
STRENGTH
4 sets:

METCON (Medium)
